judgment_calls: Staple loop is 28 tris (soft overrun of preferred 24) to keep a single closed U prism.
Hasp leaf 32 tris with true through-slot; distinct from catch plate (no screw holes, slot offset).
Knob is hex tapered frustum, 20 tris, distinct from prop-stop-knob-blank by shape and name.
Textures are flat BaseColor PNGs shipped separately; FBX carries material slots only.
contact_sheet: CONTACT_SHEET.png 2x2: top bar, hasp; bottom staple, knob
